profile: macOS dev/test, core opt-level 0; functional, not timing qualification
scope: Rooted all-table verifier and existing sequential JSON court primitive consume the same raw commitment.
All IDs of three small tables: added override, holes, absent/non-byte rendering, byte alphabet and surrogate-pair literal; chunk sizes 1, 7 and 65536, with state codec restart at every step.
Exact native key-event count succeeds on both paths; one less rejects or yields WorkBoundExceeded.
Duplicated decoded object key, duplicate vocabulary/added ID, invalid merge, premature EOF and trailing garbage refuse on both paths.
Wrong raw identity never establishes a sequential verdict.
EOG is independently authenticated by registered table, not selected by JSON; substituted EOG and wrong table rendering are rejected.
limitations: Small deterministic corpus; not exhaustive parser equivalence or actual-tokenizer all-ID sequential replay.
Compares JSON/rendering semantics only; does not equate signed moves, transport, price, timing, claim or original admission.
No production code change, public activation, transaction, TFP1 quote or Final.
